title: Middle Eastern Trout Kebabs
description: A flavorful and healthy dish featuring trout fillets marinated in a mix of Middle Eastern spices and grilled to perfection on skewers.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together spice blend, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Add the trout fillets to the marinade and coat evenly.
Thread the marinated trout, bell peppers, and onion onto skewers.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the trout is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with your favorite sides.
